answer: Each identity posts a 60-credit bond and builds one fingerprint from its own work, recorded in the ocean ledger. An auditor samples it each epoch: two identities sharing a crystal hash, or drifting from their oasis baseline, lose the bond and freeze one epoch. A farm's second fake needs a fresh fingerprint with 20 jobs, so the k-th fake still costs 60 credits plus 20 jobs, and copied fingerprints trigger a joint audit. A rented fingerprint fails on history mismatch and burns its bond. For 1,000 fakes that is 60,000 credits plus 20,000 jobs; an honest agent pays one bond.
